audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4 (Level 6) and 5 (First item) disagreed with the packet chart and with the content layer's own whys.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Jayce / Jayce / Jayce / Skill / Heimerdinger / Jayce / Jayce, and the mirror audit (jayce__heimerdinger) set exactly that. whys[4] already said the level-6 window is yours while win[4] said Jayce; whys[5] already said his Eclipse/Manamune spike out-pokes you while win[5] said Skill.
audit.corrected: Row 4 to Heimerdinger at 7/10 and row 5 to Jayce at 3/10, in matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why said 'Jayce's ultimate changes the math' as if level 6 were an all-in spike for him.
audit.why: Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer is a 6s stance swap with no cost, not a level-6 power spike — Jayce has both forms from level 6 of his weapon ranks and it is a constant, not a timing. The genuine level-6 event is your UPGRADE!!! at 100s, which is why the row belongs to Heimerdinger. His real spike is the first item.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names the stance swap for what it is and gives the row to UPGRADE!!!; phases[5].why and breakdown.late credit his item spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never stated what Shock Blast or Thundering Blow actually do, or that the stance swap carries an auto reset and a resist shred.
audit.why: Cannon Q is 16/14/12/10/8/6s and gains range, speed and damage when fired through Acceleration Gate. Hammer E Thundering Blow is 20/18/16/14/12/10s knockback at 240 range — outside that he has no displacement. Mercury Cannon's first attack in the new form reduces armour and magic resist and resets his attack, and the swap is only 6s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2] and dontsFull[1].d now carry the real cooldowns and the shred/reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: No line warned that his burst opens with an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: The stance swap resets his attack and the first hit shreds resists, so the visible weapon-change animation is the cue to move — by the time the attack lands you have already taken it.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2] repurposed to the stance-swap wind-up tell.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Jayce's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: UPGRADE!!! is a real 100s spike; his stance swap is a 6s constant, not one. Own this stage — a super-turret or a wide, long stun.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Shock Blast's cooldown.
edits.after: His first item is the swing: gated Shock Blast out-pokes the nest from outside every beam you own.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — build your teamfight around that. Jayce carry threat: 8/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: You cannot win a poke war he fires from outside beam range — hold chokes and objectives with super-turrets instead. Jayce carry threat: 8/10, so never step up alone to repair the nest.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — His main poke. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, longer and harder through Acceleration Gate. Dodge it. - Thundering Blow: 20s at rank 1, only inside 240 range. - Your grenade: flat 11s. - UPGRADE!!!: 100s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Jayce's Shock Blast: His main poke. Dodge it. When it is down — E-stun + turret him.
edits.after: Shock Blast through Acceleration Gate gains range and damage; his swap to cannon resets his auto and shreds your resists.

edits.before: His main poke. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His poke, 16s at rank 1 in cannon form. Step up once it whiffs.

edits.before: Jayce wastes Shock Blast — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Swapping stance resets his auto and shreds resists — back off then.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Thundering Blow is 20s at rank 1 and only reaches 240 units.

notes: Chart rows 4 and 5 flipped to the packet chart in matched full+content pairs; rows 0-3 and 6 already agreed. The packet's four 'probable wrong ability names' are false positives: Shock Blast and Hextech Affinity are both correct (the latter is Heimerdinger's own passive, not Jayce's Hextech Capacitor), and 'Lightning Grenade' is the E's name, which Riot's data does not carry, so I left it rather than assert a replacement. Note the mirror audit genericised those same Heimerdinger ability names on its page for that reason, so the two pages now differ in naming style but not in fact.
